best_idea: Keep a fixed pool of voices and drop the newcomer when it is full (never steal), and stage a stinger so the boss bed starts only after it ends.
decision_why: The fixed pool with drop-new and the stinger-then-bed staging fit boss intros and fights; Frankendom needs priority tiers (not in the donor) and the donor's one-shot leak, missing-buffer and stale-bed defects fixed. MIT lets us adapt the shape.
acceptance: The boss stinger plays once and the boss bed loops only after it ends with no overlap; a unit test asserts the instance count returns to zero after 100 refused one-shots, and setMusic with no piece during a stinger leaves nothing staged.
